integrity: The proof reduces minimality to leg-local seed types and one shallow-pair interaction, then maximizes the number of essential adjacent-pair seeds. A standalone exhaustive checker directly simulates zero forcing and compares every minimal set with the theorem for all spider profiles through order thirteen.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to standard zero forcing on spider trees with one branching center.
The published well-forced criterion is prior work; novelty is the all-minimal-set classification and exact upper zero forcing number.
Finite exhaustive verification through order thirteen is corroborative only.
Search coverage cannot exclude a differently phrased or non-indexed equivalent classification.
title: All minimal zero forcing sets and the upper zero forcing number of spider trees
